# Check result
print(f"Green click - Board changed: {last_action_result.get('board_changed')}, No impact: {last_action_result.get('no_impact')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Click first game green object

    n = green_game[0]
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    target_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    target_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
    print(f"\nClicking game green at row={target_row}, col={target_col}")
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': target_row, 'col': target_col}])
